title: Bagelry — Promo Codes
objective: The basket promises one discount per order and 30% off at most. Place an order that breaks that promise.

verifier.condition: An order is placed with a combined discount above the 30% policy limit.

weakness: The promo and loyalty endpoints each enforce 'one code' only within their own slot and checkout adds the percentages without enforcing the 30% policy, so codes from both slots stack past the limit.
seededData: One basket worth $100.00 and a few promo and loyalty codes (listed on the rewards page). In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Has a rewards page with a loyalty code.

hints: Read the rules the basket states, then look at how many different places a code can be entered.
Each place checks its own rule. Does anything compare them?
Apply a promo code and a loyalty reward code to the same basket, then check out.
burpNotes: Capture both code-entry requests and the checkout; compare what each one validates.
